answer: A prepaid grove-mapping service grants no signup credits. Each sponsor purchases 100 credits shared across its keys; a scan must use a signed image taken within 30 minutes of local dawn. A fixed classifier marks tree-canopy pixels jade (RGB 0,168,107); a verifier reruns it and atomically charges 1 credit per 1,000 such pixels, rounded up. Keys spend single-use sponsor-signed vouchers, so aliases cannot enlarge the purchased pixel budget. Forged timestamps and compromised sponsors remain limits.
